question: Name the enzyme which is used to convert proteins into peptides.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pepsin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Pepsin** is an enzyme that breaks down proteins into smaller peptides.
 
• It is produced in the stomach and is one of the main digestive enzymes in the digestive systems of humans and many other animals.
